plugins.name: Cards & Containers Control
plugins.author: Nexus Community
plugins.description: Use SELECT MODE ON/OFF in Plugin Manager, then click cards/containers to make them dim + inactive.
plugins.configureHint: Use SELECT MODE ON/OFF in the plugin row. Popup is optional.

info.title: Cards & Containers Control
info.what: Lets you disable specific cards/containers in the UI so they are dimmed and inactive.
info.how: Turn SELECT MODE ON, click cards/containers to set them inactive, then turn selection mode OFF.
info.usage: Use SELECT MODE in the plugin row and click targets. Use CLEAR DISABLED to reset all selections.
notes: Best used for locking parts of the interface during focused sessions.
